summary: DataMeds AI filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 settlement with the RxERP selling holders group, including Brian Norton as Seller Representative, Nomad Capital LLC and Strategix Global LLC. The Company paid $450,000 total, with $350,000 for repurchase and extinguishment of 364,099 common shares (approximately $0.96/share implied) and $100,000 to settle all MIPA claims. Litigation in Florida and Delaware Chancery is dismissed with prejudice and mutual releases exchanged. The Company anticipates extinguishing roughly $19 million in balance-sheet liability. No advisor named. Watch for share-count reduction confirmation and liability-removal impact on the next financials.
